title: New-Account Cushion on Northloop Payments Card Settlements
content:
**Rule.** A seller-authorised card settlement of a negative Northloop Payments balance carries a new-account cushion. The new-account cushion is 50.00 USD when the payments account was opened fewer than 365 calendar days before the settlement date, 20.00 USD when it was opened at least 365 but fewer than 730 days before, and nothing otherwise. It is added unchanged to the settlement basis as topped up, and the card settlement amount so obtained is rounded to the cent.

| Calendar days from the opening of the payments account to the settlement date | New-account cushion |
|---|---|
| fewer than 365 | 50.00 USD |
| at least 365 and fewer than 730 | 20.00 USD |
| 730 or more | nothing |

*Boundary cases (hypothetical).* 364 days: 50.00 USD. 365 days: 20.00 USD. 729 days: 20.00 USD. 730 days: nothing.
